name: qa_record
title: OS-FINALQA FQA-5a: Record: the Shift key rows (SOURCES, RADIO), the radio seek, F2 MONITOR with the input gain read back, MEM around a take, F7 SAVE WAV (writes Samples/REC_NNN.wav); the loop is qa_looper, USB is qa_usbrec

steps.note: (a leftover Navigator is closed: F7 is CLOSE, F8 would GO since OS-NAV2)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
(the on-screen keyboard is cancelled with F7, never accepted)

steps.say: OS-FINALQA FQA-5a: the Record rows that keys and the console reach (QA-REC-001, 036, 037, 038, 039). The loop rows are qa_looper.json, USB is qa_usbrec.json, the Shift tuning and the page turn are qa_shiftrow.json. QA-REC-039 WRITES the card: one Samples/REC_NNN.wav. Needs the line input idle (a take of silence is fine)
QA-REC-001: Shift held on SOURCES: all eight keys read '-'; on RADIO F5 CH-10 and F6 CH+10

steps.note: QA-REC-001: SOURCES, the Shift key row against the simulator
QA-REC-001: RADIO, the Shift key row against the simulator

steps.say: QA-REC-038: on RADIO F6 asks the chip for the next station (the radio report names the step; needs the chip, an antenna for a real station)

steps.note: the radio before
QA-REC-038: the driver reports a seek (soft: the chip may answer too fast to catch)
QA-REC-038: the radio status reads SEEKING or LISTENING

steps.say: QA-REC-037: F2 MONITOR flips ON / OFF; the input strip's gain follows (`mon` reads it back)

steps.note: QA-REC-037: MONITOR ON (the unit prints the input strip's graph gain, 65536 in both states: the F2 state itself is in the shots)
QA-REC-037: MONITOR reads ON

steps.expect: unity\) \d+, routes MAIN \+ CUE; mon on = \d+, mon off = 0
steps.note: QA-REC-037: MONITOR OFF (same readout line; the gain stays 65536 on the unit, see the ON step)

steps.say: QA-REC-039: F7 with no take says so; then a take of two seconds (F1, F1), F7 writes Samples/REC_NNN.wav, the strip says SAVE REC_NNN DONE and the file is listed

steps.note: QA-REC-039: no take
QA-REC-036: MEM in the top bar before the take
QA-REC-036: MEM reads 100 % while the take records (the take reserves the free arena)
QA-REC-036: MEM is the share in use plus the take's size
QA-REC-039: the strip names the file (a 1.2 MB take is at SAVE REC 001 50% after 6 s and DONE inside 40 s on the unit)
QA-REC-039: a REC_NNN.wav is on the card (soft: `ls` is the console's own listing; the cmd line expands {{NAME}}, an expect does not, so the name the strip gave is not repeated here)
QA-REC-036: after F4 DISCARD MEM is back at the level from before the take

steps.say: QA-REC-045..049 (E-SREC-11, START ON LEVEL): START ON to LEVEL adds THRESHOLD and PRE-ROLL; F1 listens (WAITING FOR LEVEL) with the transport stopped; F1 again cancels with no take. THRESHOLD is set to -6 DB first so that a quiet line input does not start the take; the level start itself (a tone at the line input) is a hand check. Runtime settings only: START ON is put back to BAR at the end

steps.note: START ON: BAR, PATTERN, LEVEL
QA-REC-045: START ON LEVEL, THRESHOLD -30 DB and PRE-ROLL 50 MS under it, the cursor on THRESHOLD
THRESHOLD +6 DB: -24 DB
PRE-ROLL: 100 MS
QA-REC-046: THRESHOLD -24 DB, PRE-ROLL 100 MS
THRESHOLD to its top, -6 DB
QA-REC-047/049: the card says WAITING FOR LEVEL, the clock is 0.0 S, the transport is stopped
QA-REC-048: F1 again cancels: READY, no take
START ON back to BAR (its Delete), the two rows go

finally.note: (a leftover Navigator is closed: F7 is CLOSE, F8 would GO since OS-NAV2)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
